name: @shallbay/dsh-token-stats
description: Harness-wide token usage dashboard: aggregates billed token usage across all sessions (uncached input / cache read / cache write / output) with peak/off-peak CNY cost estimation, served at /token-stats with live refresh at /api/token-stats/refresh. The client half adds a 'Token 用量' entry above Settings in the sidebar; it opens a new browser tab on the Web and an in-app popup window on the Desktop.
